name: Mytus VII
description: Mytus VII was a planet located in the Mytus system in Wild Space. It was the site of Stars' End prison. Around 10 BBY, a job listing for security guard located at Mytus VII was put out by Stars' End Recruitment Office to employ under C.S.A. Security Police.
